# Learn Git Branching source patch

`mobile.patch` applies to pcottle/learnGitBranching commit
`8b1fd893f2c0168edd5c7a5c38204e47e2897b67` (MIT). It contains the complete source
changes used for the portable mobile simulator, including shell localization.
Build/import instructions and ownership are in `docs/GIT_BRANCHING.md`.
The upstream copyright/license is retained in the bundled public `LICENSE.txt`.
